d:
What's Up is a mellow afrobeat number in collaboration with singer/songwriter Lisa Mishra, produced by Riz Shain. KR$NA chimes in with a smooth flow on a subject (Love/Attraction) he is not usually associated with.
Audio credits:
Song name: What’s Up
Artists: KR$NA feat. Lisa Mishra
Produced by: Riz Shain
Label: Kalamkaar Music
EP: For The Day One$
